title: AI job search built around your whole application workflow | SearchBreaker
description: A structured job search workspace that helps you move from verified experience to prioritized applications and follow-up. Learn the workflow, its controls and what you can review before applying.

blocks.headline: AI job search built around your whole application workflow
blocks.lead: SearchBreaker turns your verified experience into a controlled workflow: find relevant jobs, tailor materials and track every application. You review everything before anything is sent.
blocks.reassurance: You review everything before anything is sent.

blocks.heading: How the search works
blocks.lead: Three stages, one verified profile behind all of them.

phases.title: Build one verified profile
items: Upload your existing resumes to start
Confirm your roles, results and skills once
Lock in a profile the rest of the workflow uses

phases.title: Set your targets
items: Choose the roles you want to be matched against
Get a tailored master resume for each target role
Set location, work mode and company preferences

phases.title: Search, apply and track
items: See new openings ranked against your targets
Review tailored materials before anything is sent
Track every application and what happens next

blocks.heading: What you control
blocks.lead: SearchBreaker prepares drafts and suggestions. Every step that changes your materials or contacts an employer waits for you.

points.title: Edit your experience
points.text: Your profile is the only source for resumes and applications. Change or remove any fact at any time.

points.title: Approve every material
points.text: Each tailored resume and answer waits for your review. Accept, edit or reject each proposed change.

points.title: Decide when to submit
points.text: Nothing is sent to an employer without an explicit action from you.

blocks.heading: See your application pipeline
blocks.lead: Every application, the resume version you sent and the next step, in one place.

items.title: Experienced professionals
items.text: You have years of results to draw on and need each application to show the ones that matter for that job.
items.caveat: Less useful if you apply to one or two roles a month.

items.title: Career changers
items.text: You need to show how past work maps to a new field, using only what you actually did.
items.caveat: It will not invent experience in the new field.

items.title: High-volume searchers
items.text: You apply often and need to keep versions, dates and follow-ups straight.
items.caveat: It will not send applications without your approval.

items.label: AI job finder
items.blurb: Find openings that fit your target roles.

items.label: Job matcher
items.blurb: Compare requirements with your confirmed experience.

items.label: Resume tailoring
items.blurb: Adapt your resume to each job from verified facts.

items.label: Application tracker
items.blurb: Every application and next step in one pipeline.

faqs.a: No. SearchBreaker does not host job listings. It helps you find openings from existing sources, assess fit and manage your applications in one workspace.
No. Resumes and applications use only facts you entered and confirmed. Each proposed edit shows which profile fact it comes from, and you can reject any of them.

faqs.q: Will it submit applications without my consent?
faqs.a: No. Submission always needs your explicit approval. Auto-apply, when available, runs only under rules you set and can be paused at any time.
